titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Pharaoh’s Daughter and the Sin of Solomon (ch. 64–65)
part: ch. 64–65 — Pharaoh’s Daughter and the Sin of Solomon
about: Solomon’s Egyptian wife presses him to worship her gods, and he is tricked into entering her idol-house; the author then reflects on men undone by women and on whether God forgave Solomon.

sentences.t: ፷፬ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አስሐተቶ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ወለተ ፡ ፈርዖን ።
sentences.l: 64 where she-caused-to-err-him to-Solomon daughter-of Pharaoh
sentences.i: Chapter 64: How Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray.
sentences.n: ፷፬ = 64 (፷ 60 + ፬ 4), read as a numeral; the chapter heading is the heading line itself. ኀበ is 'where, at', here a conjunction opening the topic, like a title ('how/when'); the choice between 'how' and 'when' is uncertain (?). አስሐተቶ = አስሐተት (3fs perfect of the causative አስሐተ, 'led astray', from ሰሐተ 'to err'; the subject is the daughter) + -ኦ '3ms him', contracted to -ቶ. ለሰሎሞን: ለ- marks the object (Solomon). ወለተ ፈርዖን is a construct chain 'daughter-of Pharaoh'.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ተግህደት ፡ በቅድሜሁ ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ ይኄይስ ፡ ሰጊድ ፡ ለአማልክት ፡ ከመ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እለ ፡ እምቅድሜሁ ፡ ለአቡየ ።
sentences.l: and-then she-revealed-herself before-him and-she-said-to-him it-is-better bowing to-gods as father-my and-all-of-them kings-of Egypt who before-him of-father-my
sentences.i: Then she revealed herself openly before him and said to him: 'It is better to bow to the gods, as my father did, and all the kings of Egypt who were before my father.'
sentences.n: ተግህደት is the reflexive stem (ተ-) of ገሀደ, 'be open, manifest', hence 'show oneself' (root not confirmed against Dillmann) (?); here she drops her reserve. ወትቤሎ: ወ- + ትቤ (3fs of the defective verb ይቤ 'say') + -ሎ 'to him'. ይኄይስ 'it is better' is impersonal, followed by the verbal noun ሰጊድ 'bowing'. ነገሥተ ግብጽ is a construct chain. እምቅድሜሁ ለአቡየ: -ሁ anticipates the possessor named after it ('before him, namely my father').

sentences.t: ወአውሥኣ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ሎሙሰ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ዘገብሩ ፡ በእደዊሆሙ ፡ በነሃቢ ፡ ወበጸራቢ ፡ በለሓኵ ፡ ወበሰዓሊ ፡ በወቃሪ ፡ ወበገላፊ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢኮኑ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ግብረ ፡ እደ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፡ ብርት ፡ ወዐረር ፡ ኀጺን ፡ ወልሕኵት ፡ ወእብን ፤
sentences.l: and-he-answered-her and-he-said-to-her to-them-indeed let-them-say gods-their which they-made with-hands-their by-the-caster(?) and-by-the-hewer(?) by-the-potter(?) and-by-the-painter by-the-engraver and-by-the-carver who not-they-are gods work-of hands-of man gold and-silver metal(?) and-bronze(?) iron and-clay(?) and-stone
sentences.i: He answered her: 'As for them, let them call their gods the things they made with their own hands, by caster (?) and hewer (?), by potter (?) and painter, by engraver and carver. These are not gods; they are the work of human hands: gold and silver, a metal (?) and bronze (?), iron and clay (?) and stone.'
sentences.n: Note ወአውሥኣ ወይቤላ: the subject now is Solomon ('he answered her'). ሎሙሰ: ሎሙ 'to them' + contrastive -ሰ ('as for them'). ይብሉ is a jussive/subjunctive ('let them say'). ዘገብሩ: ዘ- 'which' + 3mp perfect. The craft nouns are agent nouns (the ቀታሊ pattern, as in ሰዓሊ and ገላፊ) introduced by በ- 'by, with'; the trade words ነሃቢ, ጸራቢ, ለሓኵ are UNCERTAIN (?) and the glosses are guesses from the list of materials; ሰዓሊ 'painter/carver', ወቃሪ 'engraver', ገላፊ 'carver' are likelier. The metal names ብርት and ዐረር are uncertain (?): ብርት is not identified, ዐረር is read 'bronze, brass' as in the glossary, as is ልሕኵት 'clay' (?) (the same word recurs in ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ, the sentence on Adam). The thought echoes the biblical polemic against idols (e.g. Psalm 115:4, 'silver and gold, the work of human hands').

sentences.t: ወትብልዎሙ ፡ አማልክቲነ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ኢኮኑ ፡ አማልክቲክሙ ፤
sentences.l: and-you-call-them gods-our to-those who not-they-are gods-yours
sentences.i: 'And you call them "our gods" -- these that are not your gods.'
sentences.n: ወትብልዎሙ: ወ- + ትብሉ (2mp of ይቤ 'say, call') + -ዎሙ '3mp them'; 'call X Y' takes a double accusative (አማልክቲነ). ትብልዎሙ is plural ('you all call them'): Solomon addresses the Egyptians generally, not her alone. The shift between 'our' and 'your' gods is odd, and the sense (the Egyptians call them 'ours' though they are not gods at all) is partly inferred (?).

sentences.t: ወንሕነሰ ፡ ኢንሰግድ ፡ ለባዕድ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወለእግዝእትነ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘወሀበነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንስግድ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ወዘርእነ ፡ እምድኅሬነ ።
sentences.l: and-we-indeed not-we-bow to-other except to-God-of holy-one-of Israel and-to-lady-our Zion holy heavenly ark-of law-his of-God which-he-gave-us that we-bow to-her we and-seed-our after-us
sentences.i: 'But we, for our part, bow to no other, except to the God, the Holy One of Israel, and to our lady Zion, the holy and heavenly ark of the law of God, which he gave us, that we and our descendants after us may bow to her.'
sentences.n: ወንሕነሰ: ወ- + ንሕነ 'we' + contrastive -ሰ. ኢንሰግድ: 1cp imperfect negated. ዘእንበለ 'except, without'. 'Holy One of Israel' (ቅዱሰ እስራኤል) is the title of Isaiah 1:4, among others. Formally ለአምላከ ቅዱሰ እስራኤል is a construct chain ('the God of the Holy One of Israel'); it is read as apposition, 'the God, the Holy One of Israel' (?). ጽዮን here is the Ark itself (ታቦት), the central theology of the book: Zion = the Ark of the Covenant, a heavenly 'lady'. ታቦተ ሕጉ: construct 'ark-of law-his'; -ሁ anticipates ለእግዚኣብሔር. ዘወሀበነ: ዘ- + ወሀበ 'gave' + -ነ 'us'; the relative could refer to the ark or to God (ambiguous). ከመ ንስግድ 'that we may bow' (subjunctive); ላቲ 'to her'.

sentences.t: አውሥአቶ ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ ለእግዝእትከሰ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ዘወለድኮ ፡ ዘእምነኪር ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘኢአዘዘክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታውስቡ ፡ ኢትዮጵያዊተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ ሕብርከ ፡ ወቅርብተ ፡ ሀገርከ ፡ ጸሊማን ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ባዕድ ።
sentences.l: she-answered-him and-she-said-to-him of-lady-your-indeed he-took son-your whom you-begot of-foreign people which not-he-commanded-you that you-marry Ethiopian-woman who not-she-was kind-your and-near-one(?)-of country-your black-ones people-of other
sentences.i: She answered him: 'As for your lady -- your son, whom you begot, took (?) [her] from a foreign people, one whom it was not commanded you to marry: an Ethiopian woman, who is not of your kind nor near to your country, black, a foreign people.'
sentences.n: This sentence is a crux and the reading is uncertain (?). The ordering ለእግዝእትከሰ ('as for your lady', ለ- topic + contrastive -ሰ) ነሥአ ወልድከ ዘወለድኮ is read as 'your son, whom you begot, took'; the object is not expressed. ዘወለድኮ = ዘ- + ወለድከ (2ms perfect) + -ሁ, contracted to -ኮ: 'whom you begot'. The spelling would equally fit 1cs ወለድኩ + -ኦ ('whom I begot'), which the sense excludes since she is speaking to him. ታውስቡ is plural because the command was given to Israel. ዘኢአዘዘክሙ ከመ ታውስቡ: 'which he did not command you that you marry'; ታውስቡ 2mp subjunctive of አውሰበ 'take as wife'. ኢትዮጵያዊተ is the accusative feminine of 'Ethiopian'. ሕብር 'kind, colour, stock' (?), ቅርብተ 'near one (f.)' (?). ጸሊማን 'dark ones'. The speaker is Pharaoh's daughter.

sentences.t: አውሥኣ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ትቤሊ ፡ አንቲኒ ፡ ኢኮንኪ ፡ እምዘ ፡ አዘዘነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ንትዋሰብ ፡ ወዘመድክሙ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ዘመደ ፡ ዚአሃ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ካም ፡ ኵልክሙ ፤
sentences.l: he-answered-her and-he-said-to-her if thus you-say you-also not-you-are of-that he-commanded-us God that we-intermarry and-kin-your with kin-of hers children-of Ham all-of-you
sentences.i: He answered her: 'If you speak so, you also are not among those whom God commanded us to marry; and your kindred, together with her kindred, are children of Ham, all of you.'
sentences.n: The subject is Solomon: ወአውሥኣ ወይቤላ (his words to her). ለእመ 'if'; ትቤሊ is 2fs of ይቤ 'you say'; አንቲኒ 'you also' (-ኒ emphasis). ኢኮንኪ 'you are not' (2fs, ኮነ negated with ኢ-). እምዘ አዘዘነ: 'of that which he commanded us'. ንትዋሰብ is the reciprocal stem (ተዋሰበ 'intermarry'). The last words ዘመደ ዚአሃ ደቂቀ ካም ኵልክሙ are read as 'her kin, children of Ham, all of you' (construct chains 'kin-of her', 'children-of Ham'). Ham: Genesis 10, whose descendants include Egypt and Canaan. Reading uncertain at the clause boundaries (?).

sentences.t: ወሠሪዎ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ ካም ፡ ፯ ፡ ነገሥተ ፡ አውረሰነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘሀገረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንነብር ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ወዘርእነ ፡ እምድኅሬነ ፤
sentences.l: and-having-uprooted(?) seed-of Ham 7 kings he-gave-us-as-inheritance God of-land where we-dwell in-it for-ever we and-seed-our after-us
sentences.i: 'And when he had uprooted (?) the seed of Ham, seven kings, God gave us as an inheritance a land in which we live for ever, we and our descendants after us.'
sentences.n: ሠሪዎ is read as a perfect or participial form ('having ...') of ሠረወ 'uproot, root out' with -ዎ (?) -- the form is unclear; the sense is 'having cleared' the peoples. ፯ is the numeral 7; the 'seven kings' recall the seven nations of Deuteronomy 7:1, which God cleared from the land of Canaan. አውረሰነ: causative አውረሰ 'make inherit' + -ነ 'us'. ዘሀገረ: ዘ- before a noun, 'the [land] of ...'; the exact function is uncertain (?). ኀበ ንነብር ውስቴታ 'where we dwell in it' (resumptive pronoun).

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ጽዮንሂ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያምልኩ ፡ ኪያሃ ፤
sentences.l: and-concerning Zion-too will-of God it-was and-he-gave-them that they-serve her
sentences.i: 'And concerning Zion also, it was the will of God, and he gave [her] to them that they should serve her.'
sentences.n: ወበእንተ ጽዮንሂ: -ሂ 'also'. ፈቃደ is the construct of ፈቃድ 'will-of' (accusative in form, predicate of ኮነ). ወወሀቦሙ: 'he gave them' -- the object (Zion) is understood. ያምልኩ ኪያሃ: ያምልኩ 3mp subjunctive of አምለከ 'worship, serve'; ኪያሃ is the object pronoun 'her' (ኪያ- + -ሃ).

sentences.t: ወአንሰ ፡ ኢይሠውዕሂ ፡ ወኢይሰግድሂ ፡ ለጣዖትኪ ፡ ወኢይገብር ፡ ፈቃደኪ ፨
sentences.l: and-I-indeed not-he-sacrifices-either and-not-he-bows-either to-idol-yours and-not he-does will-yours
sentences.i: 'As for me, I will not sacrifice or bow to your idol, and I will not do your will.'
sentences.n: The three verbs are printed as 3ms imperfects (ይሠውዕ, ይሰግድ, ይገብር) although the speaker says አነ 'I' (a 1cs would be እ-, as in ኢእሠውዕ). They are left exactly as printed and nothing is emended; the sense 'I will not' is taken from አነ and from the context, and I cannot say whether the cause is scribal, editorial or a generic 'one will not' (?). -ሂ on the first two: 'either', giving 'nor ... nor'. ጣዖት 'idol'. The closing ፨ marks the end of this paragraph-sized section in the source.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብሎ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ታስተጣዕም ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ሰርከ ፡ ወነግሀ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ወመዓልተ ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ እንዘ ፡ የአብያ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ተሠነየት ፡ ወተምዕዘት ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወተከብረት ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወተዐበየት ፡ ሎቱ ፤
sentences.l: and-this while she-says-to-him while she-sweetens(?) to-him evening and-morning night and-day and-he-also while he-refuses-her one day she-was-beautiful and-she-was-gracious(?) to-him and-she-was-honoured to-him and-she-grew-great to-him
sentences.i: And while she said this to him, sweetening her words to him, evening and morning, night and day, he still refused her. One day she became beautiful to him, and gracious (?) to him, and honoured, and great in his eyes.
sentences.n: The two እንዘ clauses ('while ...') give circumstances: ትብሎ is the 3fs imperfect of ይቤ (ትብል + -ኦ 'to him'; the subject 'she' = Pharaoh's daughter), and ታስተጣዕም is from አስተጠዐመ, 'make sweet' (ጠዐመ 'taste', ጣዕም 'sweetness'), uncertain (?); the object is understood (her words). የአብያ = 3ms of አበየ 'refuse' + 'her'. ሌሊተ ወመዓልተ 'by night and by day' (adverbial accusative). The four passive-reflexive verbs ተሠነየት, ተምዕዘት, ተከብረት, ተዐበየት (all with ለ- 'to him') mean 'became beautiful / ... / honoured / great'. ተምዕዘት is uncertain (?): I follow the context ('gracious'); it could instead mean 'was angry'. Whether 'one day' (አሐተ ዕለተ) belongs with the refusing or the turning is unmarked in the Geʿez.

sentences.t: ወይቤላ ፡ ምንተ ፡ እገብር ፡ እስመ ፡ አሕሠምኪ ፡ ገጽኪ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ወነጽሮትኪኒ ፡ አኮ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘትካት ፡ ወላሕይኪኒ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ አዳም ፡ ወሰአልኒ ፡ ዘእሁበኪ ፡ ዘትፈቅዲ ፡ ወዘእገብር ፡ ለኪ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታሠንዪ ፡ ገጽኪ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘትካት ፤
sentences.l: and-he-said-to-her what I-do since you-have-turned(?) face-yours upon-me and-gaze-yours-also not like before and-appearance-yours-also not-it-is comely(?) and-ask-me what I-give-you what you-wish and-what I-do for-you that you-make-good face-yours toward-me as before
sentences.i: He said to her: 'What shall I do? For you have turned your face against me (?); your gaze is not as before, and your appearance is not comely (?). Ask me what I should give you, what you desire, and what I should do for you, so that you make your face kind toward me as before.'
sentences.n: Hard words here: አሕሠምኪ is uncertain (?) -- the form looks like a verb (perhaps a causative of ሐሠመ) with -ኪ, but the sentence is clear from context: her face has turned cold. ነጽሮት 'gaze, look'. ላሕይ 'beauty, appearance' (as in በላሕይ, the Amnon sentence); አዳም as a predicate is read 'comely, pleasing' (?), as the same predicate was read in an earlier part; 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?). ምንተ 'what' (accusative). ሰአልኒ is the imperative 'ask' + -ኒ 'me'; ዘእሁበኪ 'what I give you' (ዘ- + 1cs imperfect); ታሠንዪ is the 2fs subjunctive of አሠነየ 'make good, beautiful'. ከመ ዘትካት 'as before'.

sentences.t: ወአርመመት ፡ ወኢያውሥአቶ ፤
sentences.l: and-she-became-silent and-not-he-answers-him
sentences.i: She fell silent and did not answer him.
sentences.n: አርመመት: 3fs perfect of አርመመ 'be silent' (a quadriliteral-type verb, not a causative; root not confirmed against Dillmann) (?). ኢያውሥአቶ is printed with ያ-, which is the 3ms imperfect of አውሥአ 'answer' (ኢ- + ያውሥእ + -ቶ), though the subject is she (a 3fs would be ኢታውሥእ-). The -ቶ ending, which looks like 3fs -ት- + -ኦ, points the same way. It is left as printed and read 'she did not answer him' by sense (?).

sentences.t: ወደገመ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ዘፈቀደት ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ መሐል ፡ ሊተ ፡ በአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢተሐስወኒ ፡ ወመሐለ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀባ ፡ ዘሰአለቶ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘትቤሎ ።
sentences.l: and-he-repeated to-her word that he-do for-her what she-wished and-she-said-to-him swear to-me by-God-of Israel that not you-deceive-me and-he-swore to-her that he-give-her what she-asked-him and-that he-do for-her all that she-say-to-him
sentences.i: He repeated a word to her, that he would do for her whatever she wished; and she said to him: 'Swear to me by the God of Israel that you will not deceive me.' And he swore to her that he would give her whatever she asked of him and do for her all that she told him.
sentences.n: ወደገመ ... ቃለ 'he repeated a word' (promise). ዘፈቀደት 'that which she wished' (ዘ- + 3fs). መሐል is the imperative of መሐለ 'swear' (+ ሊተ 'to me'); በአምላከ እስራኤል 'by the God of Israel'. ከመ ኢተሐስወኒ: 'that you not deceive me' (ሐሰወ is read as 'deceive, lie to', ?). የሀባ: 3ms subjunctive of ወሀበ 'give' + -ሃ 'her'. ዘሰአለቶ 'what she asked him'.

sentences.t: ወአሰረት ፡ ፈትለ ፡ ለይ ፡ በመንፈቀ ፡ ኆኅታ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ አማልክቲሃ ፡ ወአምጽአት ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ አንበጣ ፡ ወነበረት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አማልክቲሃ ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ ባእ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ትብትክ ፡ ፈትለ ፡ ለይ ፡ ደኒነከ ፡ ወቅትሎሙ ፡ ለእሉ ፡ አንበጣ ፡ በቅድሜየ ፡ ወክላዕ ፡ ክሳውዲሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: and-she-tied thread-of ləy(?) at-half-of door-her of-house-of gods-her and-she-brought three locusts and-she-sat in house-of gods-her and-she-said-to-him come-in to-me without you-break thread-of ləy(?) you-bending(?) and-kill them these locusts before-me and-cut(?) necks-their
sentences.i: She tied a thread of ... (?) halfway across the doorway of the house of her gods, and brought three locusts, and sat down inside the house of her gods. She said to him: 'Come in to me without breaking the thread, stooping (?), and kill these locusts before me and cut (?) their necks.'
sentences.n: ፈትለ ለይ: 'thread' + ለይ, a material or kind of thread I cannot determine (?). መንፈቀ ኆኅት 'half (of) the door'. ባእ is the imperative of ቦአ 'enter'; ዘእንበለ ትብትክ 'without your breaking' (subjunctive of በተከ 'break, cut'). ደኒነከ is uncertain (?) -- perhaps 'having bent yourself down, stooping'. ቅትሎሙ ... imperative 'kill them'. ክላዕ is uncertain (?): the stem is that of ከለዐ; 'cut off' is a guess; ክሳውዲሆሙ is the plural of ክሳድ 'neck' + 'their'. The test is a trap: it cannot be done without bowing and entering the idol-house, which he has sworn to do whatever she asks.

sentences.t: ወገብረ ፡ ከማሁ ።
sentences.l: and-he-did likewise
sentences.i: And he did so.
sentences.n: ከማሁ 'likewise, like him/it' (ከማ- + -ሁ). He does as she says, entering her idol-house.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎ ፡ አነ ፡ እገብር ፡ እምይእዜሰ ፡ ፈቃድከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሦዕከሂ ፡ ወሰገድከሂ ፡ ለአማልክትየ ።
sentences.l: and-she-said-to-him I I-will-do from-now-indeed will-yours since you-sacrificed-too and-you-bowed-too to-gods-my
sentences.i: She said to him: 'From now on I will do your will, since you have sacrificed, and bowed, to my gods as well.'
sentences.n: እምይእዜሰ: እም- 'from' + ይእዜ 'now' + contrastive -ሰ. ሦዕከሂ and ሰገድከሂ are 2ms perfects, each with -ሂ 'also'. ሠውዐ 'sacrifice'; the lexical stem of the first is read as ሠውዐ (?) with a contracted spelling.

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ማሕላሁ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይብላዕ ፡ ማሕላሁ ፡ ዘአምሐለቶ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ከመ ፡ ጌጋይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በዊእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አማልክቲሃ ፨
sentences.l: and-he-indeed because-of oath-his he-did thus that not he-eat(=break) oath-his which she-made-swear-him while he-knows that sin it-is entering into house-of gods-her
sentences.i: He, however, did this because of his oath, so as not to break his oath, which she had made him swear, though he knew that it was a sin to enter the house of her gods.
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'and he, however'. ኢይብላዕ ማሕላሁ: literally 'that he not eat his oath', i.e. violate it (a figure of speech; the verb is በልዐ 'eat', ?). ዘአምሐለቶ 'which she made him swear': አምሐለት (3fs perfect of the causative አምሐለ, 'make swear, adjure', from መሐለ) + -ኦ 'him', contracted to -ቶ. This fits the scene, where she says 'swear to me' (መሐል ሊተ); a 3ms 'he made her swear' would be written አምሐሎ, not the printed form (?). እንዘ ያአምር 'while knowing'; ጌጋይ 'sin, fault'; በዊእ is the verbal noun 'entering'.

sentences.t: ወእግዚኣብሔርኒ ፡ አዘዞሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ኢታውስቡ ፡ እምአንስተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትስሐቱ ፡ ቦቶን ፡ በአማልክቲሆን ፡ በእከየ ፡ ምግባሪሆን ፡ ወበጣዕመ ፡ ቃሎን ፤
sentences.l: and-God-too he-commanded-them to-children-of Israel saying not-take-wives from-women-of other that not you-err by-them by-gods-their by-evil deeds-their and-by-sweetness-of word-their
sentences.i: And God also commanded the children of Israel, saying: 'Do not take wives from foreign women, lest you go astray through them, through their gods, through their evil deeds and through the sweetness of their words.'
sentences.n: ወእግዚኣብሔርኒ: -ኒ 'also'. ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children-of Israel' (construct). ኢታውስቡ is the negative imperative of አውሰበ 'take as wife' (2mp), cf. Deuteronomy 7:3-4 and 1 Kings 11:2, where Israel is forbidden to intermarry lest the heart be turned to other gods. ከመ ኢትስሐቱ 'lest you err' (ሰሐተ). ቦቶን: preposition በ- 'through' + -ቶን '3fp them'. The plural feminine suffixes (-ቶን, -ሆን, and ቃሎን for ቃል + -ሆን) refer to the women.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ያደክማ ፡ ልበ ፡ ወራዙት ፡ የዋሃን ፡ በጣዕመ ፡ ቃሎን ፡ ድኩማት ፡ ወበሥነ ፡ ላሕዮን ፡ ይዘርዋ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ አብድ ።
sentences.l: for they-weaken heart-of young-men simple by-sweetness-of word-their weak-ones and-by-beauty-of appearance-their they-scatter wisdom-of man foolish
sentences.i: For these women, weak as they are, weaken the heart of simple young men by the sweetness of their words, and by the beauty of their appearance they scatter the wisdom of a foolish man.
sentences.n: ያደክማ is the 3fp imperfect (አደከመ 'make weak'), and ይዘርዋ the 3fp of ዘረወ 'scatter'; ድኩማት is the feminine plural adjective 'weak' (the women). ወራዙት 'young men' (plural of ወሬዛ) and የዋሃን 'simple, innocent ones'. ሥነ ላሕዮን: construct 'beauty-of their appearance'. The last chain ጥበበ ብእሲ አብድ is read 'wisdom of a foolish man' (?), i.e. even a wise man becomes a fool.

sentences.t: መኑ ፡ ይጠብብ ፡ እምሰሎሞን ፡ ወስሕተ ፡ በብእሲት ፤
sentences.l: who he-is-wise more-than-Solomon and-he-erred through-woman
sentences.i: Who is wiser than Solomon -- and he erred through a woman?
sentences.n: መኑ 'who'; ይጠብብ is 3ms imperfect of ጠበበ 'be wise' with እም- of comparison ('more than'). ወስሕተ: ወ- circumstantial + 3ms perfect of ሰሐተ 'err' ('and yet he erred'). The next four units follow the same rhetorical pattern: a list of exemplars who were undone by a woman. Solomon: 1 Kings 11:1-8.

sentences.t: ወመኑ ፡ ይጸድቅ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወስሕተ ፡ በብእሲት ፤
sentences.l: and-who he-is-righteous more-than David and-he-erred through-woman
sentences.i: And who is more righteous than David -- and he erred through a woman?
sentences.n: David and Bathsheba, 2 Samuel 11. ይጸድቅ 3ms imperfect of ጸድቀ 'be righteous'.

sentences.t: ወመኑ ፡ ይጸንዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ወስሕተ ፡ በብእሲት ፤
sentences.l: and-who he-is-strong more-than Samson and-he-erred through-woman
sentences.i: And who is stronger than Samson -- and he erred through a woman?
sentences.n: Samson and Delilah, Judges 16. ይጸንዕ 3ms imperfect of ጸንዐ 'be strong'. Spelling ሳምሶን.

sentences.t: ወመኑ ፡ ይሤኒ ፡ በላሕይ ፡ እምነ ፡ አምኖን ፡ ወስሕተ ፡ በእኅቱ ፡ ትዕማር ፡ ወለተ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡሁ ፤
sentences.l: and-who he-is-beautiful in-appearance more-than Amnon and-he-erred with-sister-his Tamar daughter-of David father-his
sentences.i: And who is more handsome than Amnon -- and he erred with his sister Tamar, the daughter of David his father?
sentences.n: Amnon, David's son, who wronged Tamar: 2 Samuel 13. ይሤኒ 3ms imperfect of ሠነየ 'be beautiful'. ወለተ ዳዊት አቡሁ is a construct chain with the apposition 'David his father' (-ሁ refers to Amnon).

sentences.t: ወአዳምኒ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ ልሕኵቱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወስሕተ ፡ በሔዋን ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ወበይእቲ ፡ ስሕተት ፡ ተፈጥረ ፡ ሞት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፍጥረት ፤
sentences.l: and-Adam-too first-of formed-thing-his(?) of-God and-he-erred through-Eve wife-his and-through that error it-was-created death over all creation
sentences.i: And Adam also, the first of God's creatures (?), erred through Eve his wife, and through that error death came into being over all creation.
sentences.n: ቀዳሜ ልሕኵቱ ለእግዚኣብሔር: 'first of his clay, of God' -- ልሕኵት is read 'something formed, a creature' (?), as in the earlier glossary entry; 'clay' (cf. ወልሕኵት in the list of materials in the sentence ወአውሥኣ ወይቤላ ሎሙሰ) is the alternative (?); ለ- in ለእግዚኣብሔር marks the possessor (-ሁ anticipates it). Genesis 2-3. ተፈጥረ is the passive of ፈጠረ 'create' ('was created'). Compare Romans 5:12 for the idea that death entered through the first sin.

sentences.t: ወይእቲ ፡ ስሕተተ ፡ ተባዕት ፡ እምአንስት ፡ ተፈጥረት ፡ እምሔዋን ፡ እስመ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ሔዋን ፡ ኵሎን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-that error-of male from-women it-was-created from-Eve since daughters-of Eve all-of-them
sentences.i: And that error of the man came about from women, from Eve, for all women are daughters of Eve.
sentences.n: ይእቲ ... ተፈጥረት: the feminine 'she/that' and the feminine verb agree with ስሕተት 'error' (fem. in sense). ስሕተተ ተባዕት: construct 'error-of male'. እምአንስት 'from women' (plural of ብእሲት); አዋልደ ሔዋን 'daughters-of Eve'; ኵሎን 'all of them (f.)'. The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter in the source.

sentences.t: ፷፭ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኀጢአተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።
sentences.l: 65 concerning sin-of Solomon
sentences.i: Chapter 65: Concerning the sin of Solomon.
sentences.n: Chapter heading: ፷፭ = 65. በእንተ 'concerning' takes the construct (ኀጢአተ ሰሎሞን, 'sin-of Solomon').

sentences.t: ወለሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ኮኖ ፡ ጌጋየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ሰጊድ ፡ ለጣዖት ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እስመ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ጠቢብ ፡ ኮነ ፡ አብደ ፡ ወተጽሕፈ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ ።
sentences.l: and-to-Solomon-indeed it-was-to-him fault because-of bowing to-idols exceedingly since while wise he-was he-became fool and-it-was-written sin-his in book-of prophets-their
sentences.i: As for Solomon, it became a serious fault for him, because of his bowing to idols; for although he was wise he became a fool, and his sin is written in the book of their prophets.
sentences.n: ወለሰሎሞንሰ: ለ- 'to, for' + contrastive -ሰ; ኮኖ = ኮነ 'it was' + -ሁ 'to him': 'he had it (as) a fault'. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. እንዘ ጠቢብ ኮነ አብደ: 'while he was wise, he became a fool'; አብደ is the accusative of አብድ 'fool', predicate of ኮነ (as ጌጋየ is of ኮኖ), not a verb. The sin is written in the Bible (1 Kings 11); 'their prophets' = the Israelites'.

sentences.t: ወአውሥኡ ፡ እለ ፡ ሂየ ፡ ሊቃነ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ይምሕሮኑ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ጌጋይ ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፨
sentences.l: and-they-answered those there chiefs-of bishops and-they-said forgives-him-[Q] God to-Solomon because-of-this fault that it-was-written sin-his
sentences.i: The archbishops who were there answered and said: 'Does God forgive Solomon for this fault, whose sin is written?'
sentences.n: እለ ሂየ 'those who [were] there'. ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት: 'chiefs-of bishops', i.e. archbishops (a plural construct; ጳጳስ is 'bishop'). ይምሕሮኑ: ይምሕር 'he forgives' + -ሁ 'him' + -ኑ interrogative. በእንተዝ 'because of this'. ዘተጽሕፈ ኀጢአቱ 'whose sin was written' (ዘ- with resumptive -ሁ); the ዘ- may refer to Solomon or to the fault (?). The closing ፨ closes the question.

sentences.t: እወ ፡ መሐሮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኆለቈ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ወያዕቆብ ፡ ወዳዊት ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ በሰማያት ፡ እስመ ፡ ሰራዪ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለእለ ፡ አበሱ ፤
sentences.l: yes he-forgave-him God and-he-counted name-his with Abraham Isaac and-Jacob and-David father-his in book-of life in-heaven since forgiver God to-those who they-sinned
sentences.i: 'Yes: God forgave him and counted his name with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and David his father, in the book of life in heaven; for God is the forgiver of those who have sinned.'
sentences.n: እወ 'yes'. ኆለቈ 'he counted, enrolled'. ምስለ 'with'; a list of names with ወ- before the last two. መጽሐፈ ሕይወት 'book-of life' (construct); compare Psalm 69:28, Philippians 4:3, Revelation 3:5. ሰራዪ is a nomen agentis 'one who forgives' (ሰረየ 'forgive'). ለእለ አበሱ 'to those who sinned' (አበሰ 'sin').

sentences.t: ሀቡኬ ፡ አበይኑ ፡ ለአቡሁኑ ፡ የዐቢ ፡ ኀጢአቱ ፡ ወሚመ ፡ ለወልዲ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፤
sentences.l: come-now(?) greater-[Q] to-father-his-[Q] it-is-greater sin-his and-or to-son-his Solomon
sentences.i: Come now (?): was the father's sin the greater, or the sin of his son Solomon?
sentences.n: This sentence is uncertain (?). ሀቡኬ I cannot resolve: it may be a plural imperative of ሀበ 'give' with the enclitic -ኬ, an exhortation 'come now' (the earlier glossary reading), or an introductory particle. አበይኑ and ለአቡሁኑ both carry the question-enclitic -ኑ; የዐቢ is 3ms imperfect of ዐበየ 'be great'; ወሚመ 'or'. The sense (is David's sin not greater than Solomon's?) is required by the next unit, which describes David's sin.

sentences.t: ወአቅተሎ ፡ ለአርዮን ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፀብእ ፡ በምክረ ፡ ጒሕሉት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንሥኣ ፡ ለብእሲቱ ፡ ቤርሳቤሕ ፡ እሙ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ወነስሐ ፡ ወመሐሮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: and-he-had-killed Uriah in-midst-of battle by-counsel-of cunning(?) that he-take-her to-wife-his Bathsheba mother-his of-Solomon and-he-repented and-he-forgave-him God
sentences.i: David had Uriah killed in the midst of the battle by a cunning plan (?), to take Uriah's wife Bathsheba, the mother of Solomon; and he repented, and God forgave him.
sentences.n: The subject is David (understood from the previous unit). አቅተሎ is the causative of ቀተለ ('he had him killed'); አርዮን is Uriah the Hittite, 2 Samuel 11. ጒሕሉት 'cunning, deceit' (?). ይንሥኣ: 3ms subjunctive of ነሥአ 'take' + -ኣ 'her'. ቤርሳቤሕ Bathsheba; ለብእሲቱ 'his wife' is Uriah's (the -ሁ anticipates ለአርዮን); እሙ ለሰሎሞን 'his mother, Solomon's' (-ሁ anticipating the possessor). ነስሐ 'repent' (cf. 2 Samuel 12).

sentences.t: ወእንዘ ፡ ይመውትኒ ፡ አምከሮ ፡ ለወልዲ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ቅትሎ ፡ ለኢዮአብ ፡ በከመ ፡ ቀተሎ ፡ ለአሜር ፡ ወቅትሎ ፡ ለሳሚ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘረገመኒ ፤
sentences.l: and-while he-dies-indeed he-advised to-son-his Solomon saying kill-him to-Joab as he-killed-him to-Amasa(?) and-kill-him to-Shimei because-of he-who cursed-me
sentences.i: And as he was dying he advised his son Solomon, saying: 'Kill Joab, as he killed Amasa (?), and kill Shimei for having cursed me.'
sentences.n: እንዘ ይመውትኒ: 'while he is dying' (-ኒ emphatic). አምከሮ: 'he counselled him' (አምከረ). ቅትሎ, ወቅትሎ: imperatives of ቀተለ 'kill' with ለ- marking the object (ለኢዮአብ, ለሳሚ). The victim ለአሜር is uncertain (?): the spelling points to a name like Amasa or Abner, both killed by Joab (1 Kings 2:5). ዘረገመኒ 'who cursed me' (ረገመ + -ኒ 'me'); David's instruction is in 1 Kings 2:5-9, and the Shimei episode is in 2 Samuel 16.

sentences.t: ወገብረ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሞተ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡሁ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-did will-of father-his and-he-killed-them after he-died David father-his
sentences.i: And he did his father's will and killed them after David his father died.
sentences.n: ወቀተሎሙ 'and he killed them' (-ሙ 3mp). እምድኅረ 'after'. 1 Kings 2:25, 2:34, 2:46 tell of the killings.

sentences.t: ወሰሎሞንሰ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘቀተለ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ያውስብ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ሰሜናዊት ፡ እንተ ፡ ስማ ፡ አቢስ ፡ ወበእንተሰ ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ ጌጋዩ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ አነ ፡ እከሥት ፡ ለክሙ ፡ በዘ ፡ ከሠተ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-Solomon-indeed none who he-killed except brother-his when he-wished that-he-take-as-wife wife-of father-his David northern(?) whose name-her Abishag and-concerning-indeed that it-was-written fault-his of-Solomon I I-will-reveal to-you by-that he-revealed to-me God
sentences.i: But Solomon killed no one, except his brother, when he wished to take as wife the wife of his father David, a northern woman (?) named Abishag. And as for the written fault of Solomon, I will explain it to you by what God has revealed to me.
sentences.n: አልቦ ዘቀተለ: 'there is none whom he killed'; the claim sits oddly beside the previous unit, which has Solomon kill Joab and Shimei (the text treats those as carrying out his father's will). እኁሁ 'his brother' is Adonijah, 1 Kings 2:13-25. ያውስብ: 3ms subjunctive of አውሰበ. ሰሜናዊት as printed is the feminine adjective 'northern' (ሰሜን 'north'), so 'a northern woman'. Abishag is called the Shunammite in 1 Kings 1:3 and a link with that name is likely, but the printed word does not say it, so I translate what is printed (?). አቢስ is Abishag (name spelled short). In the last clause ወበእንተሰ is 'but concerning'; በዘ ከሠተ 'by that which he revealed', and the speaker is the narrator ('I') promising an explanation. The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter.
